headline: Codex drops detached review/start, and Antigravity CLI 1.4.12 lets plugins run without an API key set.

themes.title: Scripts get clearer failure signals
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.314 makes `claude -p` print the error and exit 1 when startup fails ([2.1.314](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.314)), and Antigravity CLI 1.4.11 adds `finished_reason` to JSON and stream-json output so a cut-off answer shows ([1.4.11](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.11)). Antigravity CLI 1.4.7 also made headless `-p` runs much lighter ([1.4.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.7)).
themes.so_what: scripts that trust exit code 0 or the raw output should check these signals now.

themes.title: Defaults keep moving
themes.facts: Codex turns memory v2 on for new profiles ([rust-v0.165.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.165.0)) and cuts the default thread unload delay to one minute ([rust-v0.166.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.166.0)). Claude Code widens automatic model switches to custom model names ([2.1.312](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.312)).
themes.so_what: a setting that gave you one result last week may give another now, so check the new defaults before you rely on them.

themes.title: Sandboxes and MCP locked down
themes.facts: Claude Code's sandboxed commands can no longer change the `--mcp-config` file ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)), and Antigravity CLI hides `~/.docker`, `~/.kube` and `~/_netrc` from sandboxed commands ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)).
themes.so_what: sandboxed commands that need credentials or config files now need an explicit grant, so check them after updating.

watch_next: Check any Codex API client that calls `review/start` with detached delivery before you upgrade past rust-v0.166.0.
